text:
Dana: Heads-up — customers keep misunderstanding the console SLO preview. They think clicking "preview" will trigger real notifications. we need a sane default and an implementation plan.
Omar: My vote: preview = read-only computed view. No side-effects. Console should show who would be contacted and why, plus any suppression rules.
Lina: totally. add a compact "decision trace" per recipient: e.g., "team-x (PagerDuty) — reason: escalation_level_1; suppressed: no" or "oncall-backup — suppressed: quiet-window (22:00-06:00)". This helps troubleshooting.
Dana: important: routing logic lives in routing-service. console must not re-implement. propose a new read-only endpoint: `GET /v2/routing/preview?rule_id=<id>&time=<iso>&seed=<int>&full_fanout=false`.
Omar: include `seed` so rollouts/sampling are deterministic in preview. also allow `full_fanout=true` for admins to simulate no-sampling (warn in UI).
Lina: permissions: only tenant admins + users with `notify_preview` permission. preview calls should carry `x-preview:true` header to keep them out of incident metrics.
Theo: ops concern: preview calls could flood routing-service during big rule edits. caching rules: cache keyed by (tenant, rule_id, time_bucket, seed, full_fanout) with TTL 25s. also add a per-tenant rate limit.
Dana: telemetry: log audit row: who ran preview, rule_id, params, response-hash. separate telemetry field `preview:true` and `preview_seed`. must be queryable for audits.
Omar: UI UX: show a tiny badge: "computed preview" and a tooltip: "This is a simulated view. No notifications will be sent." show suppressed entries in grey with reason.
Lina: edgecases: routing decisions that depend on live incident state (e.g., owner already escalated) should be reproducible by providing `time` param which pins oncall + incident snapshot. routing-service needs to accept `as_of=` to freeze state.
Theo: security: make sure preview doesn't leak cross-tenant info. response should only include actor names that the caller has visibility into, or redacted IDs if not visible.
Dana: good call. UX: add an "explain" link to expand the decision trace for each recipient. also surface sampling percent and whether preview used deterministic sampling.
infra-bot: created issue PLAT-5012: routing preview endpoint + console integration (read-only, deterministic sampling, audit)  https://issues/redwood/PLAT-5012
Omar: i'll draft the API shape and cache rules. Lina  can you mock the small-card designs and tooltip copy?
Lina: will do. draft copy: "Computed preview only 12; no pages will be sent. Shows who would be notified at the selected time and why."
Dana: let's try to land a minimal preview (no-full-fanout) behind a feature flag by next week. thanks everyone.
